text:
erin_finance: Heads-up: Nimbus Analytics disputed a $4,200 passthrough charge on their Dedicated invoice (INV-2025-1320). They say their SOW doesn't allow passthroughs without consent.

kai_billing: Invoice line: 
```
Dedicated commit May: $20,000
Partner GPU passthrough - May 17: $4,200
Burst overage: $0
SLA credit: $0
```
They refuse to pay the $4.2k; CS escalated.

marta_eng: I pulled placement logs. On May 17 a placement fallback routed a subset of traffic to partner-west due to an internal node OOM. Partner usage lasted ~22m and was charged at partner rates. This was not customer-requested.

ejosh_cs: Nimbus sent contract copy. Clause says "no third-party passthrough without written consent." They want full refund.

erin_finance: If this was our fault, Finance prefers to credit the customer and attempt recovery from the partner. What was our invoice from the partner?

marta_eng: Partner invoice shows $4,200 gross. However partner applied a 15% discount on their internal line item, so net partner charge to us is $3,570 but our billing surfaced the gross $4,200 to the customer. Bug: billing used gross passthrough instead of our net cost.

kai_billing: That's bad — we overstated the passthrough. Two choices: (1) full customer credit $4,200 and try to recoup $3,570 from partner, or (2) adjust invoice to reflect our net cost $3,570 and split the difference with the customer as a one-time gesture. Which does Finance prefer?

erin_finance: Prefer option 1 (full credit) for customer experience. Finance will absorb the difference if partner recovery fails. Add reason code DED-PARTNER-OVERSTATED. Need Legal to chase partner contract.

oliver_legal: I'll open a recovery notice to partner and reference their invoice PID-8021. Also checking partner contract for breach / misbilling. We should freeze passthrough billing until partner responds.

kai_billing: I'll draft adjustment ADJ-10021 for $4,200 credit and create BIL ticket. Also will update billing logic to display passthrough net-to-us, not gross partner list price.

billing-bot: Ticket created: BIL-4715 - "ADJ-10021 credit INV-2025-1320 (DED-PARTNER-OVERSTATED)". Audit trail started.

ejosh_cs: I'll notify Nimbus that we've issued a full credit while we investigate and include BIL-4715. They appreciate the quick action.

marta_eng: Added a postmortem draft. Root cause: OOM in dedicated host + billing mapping bug that picks partner list price instead of accounting net. Patch in review.

erin_finance: Approve full credit. Finance asks Billing to add a short memo on adjustment: "Credit issued due to partner passthrough overstatement; recovery from vendor in process." Also request weekly status until partner resolves.

kai_billing: Noted. Will attach partner invoice and Legal recovery threads to BIL-4715. Will also add a test for passthrough pricing mapping in the billing pipeline.

oliver_legal: Sent initial recovery notice to partner. If partner refuses to refund net charge, propose we categorize $630 (the difference) as vendor dispute expense and track to the partner-cost-recovery ledger.

erin_finance: Approved. Finance will track vendor-dispute expense line. Please close this thread once ADJ posts and Nimbus is notified.

kai_billing: ADJ created and posted. Email to Nimbus sent with refund confirmation. Closing BIL-4715 when partner responds.

erin_finance: Thanks team. Let's also add a short onboarding checkbox for passthrough consent on new Dedicated contracts so customers aren't surprised.
